description:
You are an energy auditor calibrating a model for the 4StoreyBuilding project. The building owner has completed an IT equipment modernization on the middle floors (Floors 2 & 3), replacing old desktops with efficient thin clients. Metered data suggests a reduced plug load density.

Your task is to update the eQUEST model to reflect this change:
1. Locate all Middle Floor spaces (spaces starting with 'M.').
2. Change the Equipment Power Density (EQUIPMENT-W/SQFT) for these spaces to 0.65 W/ft².
3. Do not modify Ground Floor (G.*) or Top Floor (T.*) spaces.
4. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to update the results.
5. Save the project.

Note: You will need to navigate to the Building Shell module, then to Space Properties to find the Internal Loads / Equipment settings.
